layout.note: Grand Prix circuit 1978-1994 (5.031 km): F1 Brazilian GP 1978 and 1981-1989. Not an F1 venue in 2010-2026: shortened for the 2007 Pan-American Games (Curva Norte removed), closed and demolished in 2012 for the Rio 2016 Olympic Park.

findings.game: Range 5.6 m; the only relief is a 5 m hump at s 1560-1800 (approach to and exit of the Curva Norte hairpin, +3.3 % / -2.3 % over 100 m); elsewhere within 2 m.
findings.real: The hump is the 2007 Pan-American arena that replaced the Curva Norte: GLO-30 (TanDEM-X 2011-2015, the same acquisitions as the game's GLO-90) reads a 15-18 m building there (s 1500-1680). SRTM (February 2000, circuit intact) has no hump there (4-7 m along the whole lap, +-3 m noise). The venue is a coastal lowland (dataset altitude 3 m).
findings.proposedFix: Add br-1977 to FLAT_TRACKS in tools/build-tracks.mjs (heavy smoothing, range capped at 4 m), or take the elevation from SRTM 30 m (pre-demolition) instead of GLO-90 (proposedCorrections.flatTrack).
sources: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (DSM, 30 m), AWS open data COGs s3://copernicus-dem-30m (cache/glo30/)
NASA SRTM GL1 v3 30 m via api.opentopodata.org/v1/srtm30m (cache/opentopodata/srtm30m/)

findings.game: Dataset layout: 5.035 km lap, 23 corners, anticlockwise.
findings.real: Cannot be checked against OpenStreetMap: the circuit was demolished in 2012 (no raceway ways remain). OpenHistoricalMap has only 3 rough ways traced from a Wikipedia image of the later short circuit (cache/ohm/br-1977.json); they lie within 1-30 m of the game line where they share the road and up to 300 m away elsewhere. The lap length matches the official 5.031 km (+0.1 %).
Side not verifiable (demolished, no OSM pit way). Formula One had no pit-lane speed limit until 1994, after the circuit's last GP (1989).
sources: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pit_stop: after the 1994 San Marino GP "the pit lane speed limit was introduced in Formula One" (ref/en-Pit_stop.wiki)

findings.proposedFix: None in the data; if real-banking corners should stand out more (the Zandvoort / Madring complaint), consider lowering BANK_MAX for curvature-derived banking so that unbanked hairpins do not look banked.
findings.game: Curvature-derived banking up to 5.3 deg; every corner tighter than ~35 m gets 4.5-5.9 deg (s 1368 R 22.4 m: 4.7 deg; s 1550 R 27 m: 5.3 deg; s 1690 R 25.3 m: 5.3 deg; s 3246 R 31.2 m: 4.6 deg; s 4524 R 34.7 m: 4.7 deg). No bankOverrides.
findings.real: No banked corner is documented for this circuit (Wikipedia en / pt / es, official site); OSM ways carry no banking / incline tags.

flatTrack.what: add "br-1977" to FLAT_TRACKS in tools/build-tracks.mjs (or use SRTM 2000 as its source)
flatTrack.why: the only relief in the game profile is the 2007 arena over the old Curva Norte
